_doc: Per-indicator FETCH specs for the Pressure layer — what scripts/fetch-pressure-observations.mjs pulls to compute each indicator's window % change. Mirrors data/cost-index-sources.json: every spec carries `verified`. EIA/USDM/NWS specs are VERIFIED (stable series id / keyless REST). NASS specs carry an exact `short_desc` so the API returns ONE clean series — nassSeries flattens every returned row into one sorted array, so a query matching multiple short_desc/unit_desc values interleaves several series and windowChange returns garbage. Pin short_desc, confirm the change in --probe, then go live. Keys (free): EIA_KEY, NASS_KEY. USDM + NWS are keyless. scripts/check-pressure-sources.mjs validates shape + manifest alignment and reports readiness.

diesel.note: Weekly U.S. No. 2 diesel retail (EIA Open Data v2). VERIFIED series id. Probe: rows=1682 change=-7.6%.

drought-ca-az.note: US Drought Monitor REST, CA+AZ state FIPS, severe-area share. Keyless. Endpoint returns CSV unless Accept: application/json is sent (fetcher sets it).

drought-fl-ca.note: FL+CA severe-area share. Keyless. Accept: application/json (fetcher sets it).

drought._verify: aoi=US returns empty from the StateStatistics endpoint — national needs the USStatistics/GetDroughtSeverityStatisticsByArea path, not StateStatistics. Confirm the national endpoint before flipping. The two state specs already cover the CA/AZ/FL produce zones.

freeze-alert.note: Active freeze warnings over the winter growing zones (api.weather.gov). Keyless; encodes active=+1. Probe: rows=1.

feed-futures._verify: PERMANENTLY DEFERRED (wrong source): AMS_3046 is the Minneapolis Daily Grain NARRATIVE report — rows are report headers with a report_narrative text blob, no structured close/price field. CBOT futures settlement isn't AMS data anyway (that's CME). Leave as an unwired future slot on the meat panels (they already have 3 live signals); revisit only with a real structured grain/feed price source.

specs._movement_doc: ams-move specs pool Report Details rows from ALL active Daily Movement city reports (default list MOVEMENT_REPORTS in fetch-pressure-observations.mjs), filter to one commodity (exact), and EMIT three indicator observations — volume (national weekly lbs trend), imports (import-share trend), pace (trailing-4wk vs ~52wk-ago). The emitted ids are the rule indicators; the spec id (e.g. onion-movement) is not itself an indicator. Volume field is '1 lb units'; import flag is 'import/Export' (I=import). check-pressure-sources resolves emits → indicators.

onion-movement._verify: Probe (--probe) reports cities-hit, weeks, and the 3 emits. Confirm a sane volume change and non-null imports/pace, then flip. 'Onions, Dry' excludes Green/Processed/Seed via commodityExact.

lettuce-movement._verify: Romaine national movement. Imports likely low (mostly domestic CA/AZ) — import signal may be near-flat, which is fine.

tomato-movement._verify: Field/round tomatoes (exact 'Tomatoes' — Plum/Cherry/Grape are separate lines, matching the measured anchor). National pool fixes the single-origin Nogales seasonality; imports meaningful (Mexico via Nogales/McAllen).

potato-movement._verify: Fresh table potatoes (exact 'Potatoes' — excludes Seed/Chipper). Idaho Falls + others; mostly domestic.
